title: Stop Saying "Very Old"! 6 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very old". Say one of these instead:
• Ancient: It's ancient!
• Elderly: I helped an elderly man.
• Antique: I collect antique clocks.
• Age-old: It's an age-old tradition.
• Prehistoric: My phone is prehistoric.
• The idiom: It's as old as the hills!
